notes: *for* is placed on the dative לְ of לוֹ with the suffix taking *his own* (rule 18's emphatic possessive), leaving לְעַם unrepresented. Two competing readings are defensible: giving *for* to the second לְ, and — the one worth recording — giving it to סְגֻלָּה as the construct relation recast under rule 19, since the word stands exactly where that relation's *of* would stand. Rule 11's priority for a present function morpheme whose sense the word carries is what keeps it on the benefactive לְ.
בְּ before the object of בָּחַר is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing a bare *chosen thee*.
The face-of-the-earth chain follows rule 29's arthrous count: the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes the supplied one; nothing is fronted.
